name: processtask_step_remind
label: Work Order Step Special Reminder Information Table
description: Work order step special reminder information table used for time dimensional statistical queries and association queries related to process workflow.

fields.name: processtask_id
fields.description: Work order ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: processtask_step_id
fields.description: Step ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Actions, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the processtask_step_id, action fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_processtask_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the processtask_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
